obfuscation_indicators: forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified detail on project awards, equity issuance, debt repayment, and outstanding contingencies, but relies on standard disclaimers and several unassured outcomes. Project award reversals, litigation, unsigned PPAs, and dependence on regulatory decisions indicate meaningful execution and counterparty risk. The capital raise and Orion debt payoff improve liquidity and reduce secured debt, partially offsetting the negative risk tone.
